parameters.query:
-- Get trades from yesterday or older that need outcome verification
SELECT 
  id,
  symbol,
  timeframe,
  direction,
  entry_price,
  stop_loss,
  take_profit,
  confidence,
  rationale,
  created_at
FROM trade_ideas
WHERE is_win IS NULL  -- Not yet evaluated
  AND created_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '1 day'  -- At least 1 day old
ORDER BY created_at ASC
LIMIT 20

=-- Update trade with outcome
UPDATE trade_ideas
SET 
  is_win = {{ $json.is_win }},
  actual_exit_price = {{ $json.actual_exit_price }},
  pnl = {{ $json.pnl }},
  evaluated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  notes = COALESCE(notes, '') || E'\n\nOUTCOME: ' || '{{ $json.outcome_explanation }}'
WHERE id = {{ $json.trade_id }}
RETURNING id, symbol, direction, is_win, pnl
